sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Flight Hour Solution GmbH, Bahnhofplatz, 6300 Zug, Switzerland, is the controller of the personal data described in this notice. You can reach us at contact@flighthoursolution.com or on +41 76 595 88 61. Data protection matters are handled by the managing director, Hubert Nowosad.

This notice explains what happens to personal data when you visit this website, use the contact form, write to us, work with us or apply for a role. It follows the revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), in force since September 2023, and, where it applies to you, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Under the FADP, a private company needs no separate legal basis for processing as long as it respects the principles of the Act: lawfulness, good faith, proportionality, purpose limitation and transparency. Where the GDPR applies, the legal basis is named in each section below.
sections.source: Controller details: docs/research/01-company-profile.md sections 1, 2 and 6; docs/research/02-website-content-inventory.md section 2. Revised FADP in force since September 2023 and GDPR relevance for EU clients: docs/research/01-company-profile.md section 8. FADP principles: Article 6 FADP (SR 235.1, see sources).

sections.title: The contact and asset request forms
paragraphs: The form on the Contact page asks for your name, company, work email and message; role, phone, engine family and what you need are optional. The form on the Assets page asks for your name, company, email, the asset type, the engine or aircraft type and whether it is offered or wanted; a message is optional.

On both forms you tick a box to confirm that we may use these details to answer you and follow up. When you press send, the form posts to our server, which turns it into an email to contact@flighthoursolution.com and keeps no copy. Our reply goes to the address you gave. Nothing you enter is stored on the website.
If email delivery is not available, your own email program opens with the enquiry prepared, and you send it yourself from your own address.
A hidden field that people never see catches automated submissions. There is no CAPTCHA and no third-party bot check.

We use your entries to answer the enquiry, to follow it up and, if you instruct us, to prepare an engagement. Legal bases under the GDPR: your consent (Article 6(1)(a)) and steps taken at your request before a contract (Article 6(1)(b)). We use the entries for no other purpose.
sections.source: Fields and required flags: site/app/src/content/contact.json form.fields (name, company, email and message required; role, phone, engineFamily and need optional) and site/app/src/content/assets.json requestForm.fields (name, company, email, assetType, assetModel and need required; message optional), both enforced by site/app/src/components/site/EnquiryForm.tsx and the schema in site/app/src/site/enquiry.functions.ts (consent required on both). Assets page: site/app/src/routes/assets.tsx renders EnquiryForm with the assets.json fields, the contact.json consent text and success copy, and the subject Asset request. Server behaviour: enquiry.functions.ts (POST to a server function, email through api.resend.com to ENQUIRY_TO or contact@flighthoursolution.com with reply_to set to the visitor's address, nothing written to storage, mailto fallback when no key is configured, honeypot field website). No CAPTCHA: EnquiryForm.tsx. Legal bases: Article 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR (see sources). Code checked 20 September 2026.

sections.title: Server logs
paragraphs: The website is built and deployed on the Higgsfield website platform and runs on Cloudflare's network. Like every web host, they record each request: your IP address, the date and time, the page requested, the referring page, your browser and operating system, and the response code.

These logs exist to run the site, to defend it against attacks and to find faults. We do not keep copies of them and we do not use them to identify visitors. The providers set the retention period. Legal basis under the GDPR: our legitimate interest in a secure, working website (Article 6(1)(f)).
sections.source: Platform and edge: site/README.md and docs/website/README.md (React 19 + TanStack Start on a Cloudflare Worker, deployed through the Higgsfield website tools); live check on 19 September 2026 (server: cloudflare on every response). Worker logging: site/app/wrangler.jsonc (observability enabled). The list of logged items is the standard content of web server access logs; the retention period is the provider's and is listed in clientToConfirm. Legal basis: Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

sections.title: Email, phone and applications
paragraphs: If you email or call us, we process what you send or tell us in order to reply and to handle the matter. Our mailboxes are hosted by zenbox.pl (Cyber_Folks S.A.) in Poland, within the EU.
If you write to us on WhatsApp, your messages pass through WhatsApp's service under its own privacy terms.

If you apply for a role by email, we use your application to assess it and share it only with the people involved in the decision. Legal bases under the GDPR: steps taken at your request before a contract (Article 6(1)(b)) and our legitimate interest in answering correspondence (Article 6(1)(f)).

sections.title: Clients, suppliers and business contacts
paragraphs: When you work with us as a client, a supplier, an engine shop or an authority, we process the business contact data of the people involved: names, roles, work contact details and the correspondence of the engagement. Legal bases under the GDPR: performance of a contract (Article 6(1)(b)) and our legitimate interest in running our business (Article 6(1)(f)).
sections.source: Audiences per docs/research/07-recommendations-and-brief.md section 3 (airlines, lessors, MROs, government operators, brokers) and docs/research/01-company-profile.md section 4. Legal bases: Article 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR.

sections.title: Who receives your data
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data and we do not use it for advertising. The following service providers process data on our behalf, under data processing terms that bind them to our instructions and to confidentiality.
Higgsfield, the website platform on which the site is built and deployed, and Cloudflare, on whose network the site runs and which records the request logs described above.
Resend, the email delivery service that carries the contact form to our mailbox, and zenbox.pl (Cyber_Folks S.A., Poland), which hosts that mailbox.

Beyond these, we disclose personal data only to professional advisers bound by confidentiality, to authorities when the law requires it, or where necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
sections.source: Processors named per site/content-brief/VOICE-AND-FACTS.md (Legal: name actual processors, Cloudflare through the Higgsfield hosting platform, the contact form sends an email). Higgsfield and Cloudflare: site/README.md. Resend: site/app/src/site/enquiry.functions.ts (api.resend.com). Mailbox host: docs/research/04-technical-audit.md section 1. Data processing terms: to be confirmed, see clientToConfirm.

sections.title: Transfers outside Switzerland and the EEA
paragraphs: Cloudflare and Resend are companies based in the United States. Cloudflare runs a global network, so your requests are handled at the location nearest to you, which may be outside Switzerland and the European Economic Area. Higgsfield may also process data outside these areas.

For such transfers we rely on the safeguards in the providers' data processing terms: the European Commission's standard contractual clauses, with the additions the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner requires, or another mechanism recognised by Swiss and EU law. You can ask us which safeguard applies in a given case.
sections.source: Cross-border disclosure rules: Articles 16 and 17 FADP and Chapter V GDPR (Articles 44 to 49), see sources. Provider locations and the safeguards actually in place are to be confirmed by the client and counsel, see clientToConfirm; the paragraph is written so that it stays true under either standard contractual clauses or an adequacy-based mechanism.

sections.title: How long we keep data
paragraphs: Form enquiries and emails: for as long as it takes to answer and follow up. If no engagement follows, we delete them once the matter is closed.
Applications: until the decision on the application has been made and communicated, unless you ask us to keep your details for future roles.
Business records that document an engagement, such as contracts, invoices and the accounting records behind them, are kept for ten years, as the Swiss Code of Obligations requires.
Server logs: for the period set by the hosting providers, as described under Server logs.
sections.source: Ten-year retention of accounting records, vouchers and reports: Article 958f of the Swiss Code of Obligations (SR 220), see sources. Other periods are criteria rather than fixed durations; a fixed period for enquiries is proposed in clientToConfirm.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask us what data we hold about you and receive a copy. You can ask us to correct it, delete it, restrict its use, or hand it over in a common electronic format. You can object to processing based on our legitimate interests, and withdraw consent at any time; withdrawal does not affect what was done before.

Write to contact@flighthoursolution.com or to the postal address above. We may ask you to confirm your identity before we answer. We reply within 30 days; if a request is complex, we tell you why we need longer.

You can also complain to a supervisory authority: in Switzerland, the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC, edoeb.admin.ch); in the EU or EEA, the data protection authority of the country where you live or work.
sections.source: Rights: Articles 25 (access, answer within 30 days), 28 (data portability) and 32 (rectification, deletion, objection) FADP; Articles 12(3) (one month), 15 to 21 and 77 (complaint) GDPR, see sources. FDPIC: https://www.edoeb.admin.ch/ (checked reachable on 19 September 2026).

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: The site is delivered over an encrypted connection (HTTPS with HSTS) and sends strict security headers to your browser. Form entries travel encrypted to our server and on to the email service. Nothing you enter is stored on the website or its server, and access to our mailbox is limited to the people who handle enquiries.
sections.source: site/app/src/lib/security-headers.server.ts and site/app/src/server.ts (Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy on every response); site/app/app.manifest.json (no database, object storage or key-value store provisioned); site/README.md (no personal data stored on the server). Mailbox access practice: to be confirmed, see clientToConfirm.

sections.title: Cookies, analytics and third-party content
paragraphs: This website sets no cookies of its own and uses no analytics, no advertising tags, no social media plug-ins and no fonts loaded from third parties. Fonts, images and videos are served from our own host. We make no automated decisions about you and build no profiles. Details are in the cookie notice.

Links to LinkedIn, WhatsApp, the commercial register and the Swiss Aerospace Cluster lead to third-party sites. Nothing is sent to them until you follow a link; from then on their own privacy terms apply.

sections.title: The short version
paragraphs: This website sets no cookies of its own and stores nothing in your browser beyond what is technically necessary to deliver the pages. There is no analytics, no advertising and no consent banner, because there is nothing to consent to.

sections.title: What technically necessary means here
paragraphs: Your browser keeps a temporary copy of pages, fonts, images and videos so that they load faster next time. This is the ordinary browser cache, not a cookie: it holds no personal data, sends nothing to us and clears itself under your browser's rules.
The site reads your browser's reduced-motion setting to decide whether to play animations and the home-page film. It reads the setting on each visit and stores nothing.

The network that serves the site (Cloudflare, through the Higgsfield hosting platform) may set a short-lived security cookie if it has to check that a visitor is not an automated client. Such a cookie is strictly necessary and holds no profile of you.
sections.source: Reduced-motion read through matchMedia with nothing stored: site/app/src/components/site/MotionProvider.tsx and PageMotion.tsx; film never fetched under reduced motion: docs/website/README.md. Edge network: site/README.md and the live check of 19 September 2026 (server: cloudflare, no Set-Cookie on the responses seen). The security-cookie sentence is conditional and is listed in clientToConfirm for a check against the production headers.

sections.title: What we do not use

The contact form runs without a CAPTCHA. A hidden field that people never see filters automated submissions.
